ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering the central and anterior areas, transitioning to a high-intensity mottled region near the tip. Right lobe: Predominantly high-intensity (white) background with 8-10 discrete, high-contrast low-intensity circular blobs scattered across the mid-field and lateral quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 28 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Right lobe: Lower-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks, with a smoother profile relative to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from notch to tips; left lobe tip exhibits a blunt, irregular termination due to significant edge erosion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (3-15 pixels in diameter) localized primarily on the right lobe's high-intensity surface and the distal end of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, dark linear pixel streaks (~20-50 pixels in length) oriented diagonally across the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and heavy serration along the left lobe trailing edge, indicating healed physical trauma or intense environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme morphological asymmetry between the left and right trailing edges.
